python3 - <<'PY'
import os, json, pathlib, datetime
from datetime import timezone, timedelta
tz=timezone(timedelta(hours=8))
day=datetime.date(2026,11,11)
root=pathlib.Path("/Users/mac/.cursor/projects/Users-mac-Desktop-CHcode/agent-transcripts")
rows=[]
for p in root.glob("*.jsonl"):
    m=datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(p.stat().st_mtime, tz)
    if m.date()!=day: continue
    # skim first user/assistant for topic
    topic=""
    try:
        with p.open(errors="ignore") as f:
            for i,line in enumerate(f):
                if i>40: break
                try: o=json.loads(line)
                except: continue
                role=o.get("role") or o.get("type") or ""
                text=""
                if isinstance(o.get("message"), dict):
                    c=o["message"].get("content")
                    if isinstance(c,str): text=c
                    elif isinstance(c,list):
                        text=" ".join(x.get("text","") for x in c if isinstance(x,dict))
                elif isinstance(o.get("content"), str):
                    text=o["content"]
                if text and ("user" in str(role).lower() or role in ("human","user")):
                    topic=text.replace("\n"," ")[:160]
                    break
                if not topic and text:
                    topic=text.replace("\n"," ")[:120]
    except Exception as e:
        topic=str(e)
    rows.append((m.strftime("%H:%M"), p.name, topic))
rows.sort()
for t,n,topic in rows:
    print(f"{t} {n} :: {topic}")
print(f"count={len(rows)}")
PY
